scenes.title: Don't hope the agent behaves
scenes.sub: Understand and control what your agents are doing.
say: This is a story about behaviour, not about files.

scenes.text: it's about behavior. It's not just about, files and permissions
scenes.caption: Permissions say who may touch what. Behaviour is what the agent actually does with it.
